programmes.d: Mann is a gunman informed by a childhood friend that his father was murdered years earlier by his mother and her lover.

Lola, a saloon dancer, arrives in Sant'Anna, a town terrorized by outlaw El Diablo, who aims to sell the land to a railroad. With the help of Rod, a young admirer, Lola inspires the townspeople to rise up and fight for their land.

Con artists Jonathan and Sebastian roam the West seeking easy riches. When magic elixirs and card tricks fail, they target the eccentric Eldorado. Recruiting Ringo Jones and enlisting Eldorado’s niece Juanita, they plot the heist - but with so much at stake, can trust survive among them?

During the Civil War, three outlaws face execution for selling guns to the enemy — until a Confederate general spares them. Their mission: recover a hidden fortune in gold under the watch of an officer. But rival treasure hunters turn their path to freedom into a deadly race.
Just when Cjamango has won a bag of gold in a poker game, he is attacked by the gangs of El Tigre and Don Pablo.
The adopted son of a preacher comes upon a village that is under the thumb of a deranged ex-Confederate officer, who is - among other things - stealing land from the locals with phony land grants.
Western spaghetti set in gold rush times in California, involving circus acrobats, outlaws and a gold mine.
A mysterious woman persuades two cowboys to help her in a revenge scheme.

A poor Mexican farmer, evicted from his land, turns to banditry and ends up in prison. While he serves his sentence, his young son is adopted by a wealthy family. Once freed, he sets out to reclaim both his child and the $200,000 he hid after a bank robbery, facing a struggle between love and greed.

In the final months of the Civil War, Joe’s brother is unjustly slain by a Northern captain. Consumed by grief and fury, Joe joins a band of Southern fighters who refuse to surrender, seeking justice and redemption amid the dying embers of war.

programmes.t: The White, the Yellow and the Black
programmes.d: In the 19th century, when the Japanese Emperor sends a gift pony to the US President it gets stolen and ransomed by Indians but Sheriff Gideon aided by an inept Japanese servant offers to deliver the ransom.

Bounty hunter Stan Ross arrives in Canyon City, drawn by a bank robbery. Hired by the town’s powerful banker Jefferson, he hunts down a gang of Mexican bandits - only to uncover shocking secrets. As Ross digs deeper, he realizes Jefferson’s grip on the town is far more dangerous than he thought.
An avenging outsider riddles a gang of ruthless bandits in revenge for the murder of his family.

programmes.t: May God Forgive You... But I Won't
programmes.d: While Cjamango is away from his ranch six bandits attack and kill all the members of his family.
Ramon avenges his brother's murder and kills the Baxter Family.
